characters.name: Mand
characters.description: A confident and adventurous man, possibly middle-aged, with a medium build. He has short, slightly wavy brown hair and a neatly trimmed beard. His facial features are sharp with bright, determined eyes. He wears practical traveling clothes suitable for a long journey, including sturdy boots and a dark cloak. He is seen traveling through a dense forest path, emphasizing his quest and determination to find the king's daughter.

characters.name: Sörveivolleierne
characters.description: Three enigmatic figures, the Söørveivollere, are seen working together on some mysterious task. They are of average height and build, wearing long, dark robes with hoods that partially veil their faces. Their appearance is somewhat mystical and they exude an aura of knowledge and secretive purpose. They are depicted at a distance, suggesting that they are deeply absorbed in their work, hinting at their connection to magical or mysterious activities.

characters.name: Lap-Kone
characters.description: An elderly woman with a kindly face but eyes that suggest wisdom and experience. She is of short stature and slightly stout, with long, grey hair pulled back into a neat bun. Wearing simple, traditional clothing suitable for cooking, she seems to be a caretaker of the place. The scene is a cozy, rustic cottage interior where she sits stirring a pot of porridge over a fireplace, giving off a warm and inviting atmosphere.
